show.description: Ghar Wapsi: Ek Yoddha Ki Kahani is the story of Surya, a disciplined warrior raised in an ashram who sets out to find his lost family with only a mysterious pendant as his clue. His journey leads him into a dangerous world of power, crime, and rivalry, where he becomes the protector of Tara - a brilliant scientist targeted by powerful enemies. As secrets unfold, Surya discovers that the very family he is fighting for is his own, forcing him to confront betrayal, identity, and forgiveness.
